subject: Re: Packaging and discount path for retention + tracing + advanced visuals
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@datumai.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-02-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask — retention / tracing / advanced dashboards pricing

Hi Rohan & Kimberly,

Thanks for taking time last week. We're finalizing next quarter's vendor consolidations and would like a compact view of how Redwood prices the observability addons: long-term retention, high-cardinality tracing ingestion, and the advanced visualization pack. High level context:
- Current footprint: ~50M spans/month, 25 TB of active storage across index tiers, ~120 dashboard seats but only ~40 heavy users.
- Budget target: $60k/mo total for addons, but flexible if we can show clear ROI.
- Timeline: procurement signs off in mid-March; legal needs a draft SOW by March 7.

Can you share: 1) a simple SKU-style breakdown (retention buckets + per-TB or per-day pricing), 2) tracing ingestion tiers and typical per-span costs, and 3) pricing for the advanced visuals (per-seat vs site license). Also curious on standard discounting for a 12–18 month committed deal and any ingress/egress smoothing for month-to-month spikes.

I've attached a usage snapshot for March–Jan to help sizing. Interested in a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Ops, DatumAI
Samantha.lee@datumai.com
Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@datumai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-02-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention / tracing / advanced dashboards pricing

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear context and the snapshot. High level answers below and I attached a simple workbook that maps your numbers to three packaging options.

Short summary (details in attached pricing_model_v3.xlsx):
- Retention: three buckets — 30d (included), 90d (+$0.02/GB/mo), 365d (+$0.12/GB/mo). We also offer a mixed tier for hot/cold separation which reduces the effective per-GB price for mostly-cold datasets.
- Tracing ingestion: tiered by spans/month: up to 10M (base), 10–100M ($0.00008/span), 100M+ (negotiated slab). Your 50M spans/month maps to the mid-tier.
- Advanced visuals: two models — per-seat ($40/user/mo for heavy users) or org license ($3,500/mo for up to 250 seats). Given you have ~40 heavy users we usually recommend the per-seat or a hybrid (org license + scalable seats).

Discounting and concessions: standard 12-month commit = 10% off list for addons; 18-month = 15% with minimal SLAs; for 24-month we can go to 20% subject to a usage commit. We can also offer a 3-month overage credit (first-time smoothing) for your first billing period after onboarding.

Next steps: 1) tell me which packaging column (Essentials / Performance / Enterprise) you prefer from the workbook, 2) confirm procurement timing and sign-off owners, and 3) we'll draft a SOW for legal. Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing_model_v3.xlsx
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@datumai.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-cto@datumai.com
Date: 2028-02-28T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention / tracing / advanced dashboards pricing

Thanks, Rohan — that workbook is helpful. A few clarifying Qs before we escalate to procurement/legal:
1) Is the 365d tier applied uniformly, or can we apply it only to selected indices (e.g., infra logs vs. app traces)? Our goal is to keep full-year retention for infra but keep app traces at 90d.
2) On tracing slabs: can you confirm the delta between the 50M span mid-tier and the 100M negotiated slab? We may have short bursts to 120M.
3) Advanced visuals: curious whether the org license includes auto-scaling DASH nodes for spikes or if that's an additional charge.

Procurement timeline: we need a SOW draft by March 7 and target signatory is our procurement lead (procurement@datumai.com). If you can include the discount path for an 18-month commit and the proposed overage smoothing language that would be ideal.

Also, can you add a simple SOW checklist so our legal can speed review?

Samantha
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@datumai.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention / tracing / advanced dashboards pricing

Forwarding Samantha's clarifying questions — suggested commercial response below that we can put into a SOW checklist and pricing call script.

Suggested offer (commercial ops perspective):
- Retention: support index-level retention. So DatumAI can apply 365d to infra indices and 90d to app traces. We'll include a single line item for "tiered retention policy" and estimate TBs per index group in the workbook.
- Tracing slabs: for 100M+ spans we'll set an overage slab at $0.00006/span. For bursts above 120M we will apply a smoothing credit: 50% of the overage charge will be credited for the first 90 days post-onboarding (to give you runway).
- Advanced visuals: include org license at $3,500/mo that covers up to 250 seats and includes auto-scaling DASH nodes for traffic spikes up to 2x baseline. Beyond that, excess compute billed at a predictable per-hour rate.

Discount/concession ask: recommend offering 18-month commit at 15% off addon list with the following guardrails — minimum monthly commitment at 90% of current forecast and a carve-out that allows renegotiation at renewal if usage is >150% of forecast.

Ben — can you sign off on the 15% and the smoothing credit? If yes, I'll draft the SOW checklist and a short paragraph for legal on the overage smoothing mechanics. HubSpot deal link is included below.

--Kim
Attachment: DatumAI_SOW_draft.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DA-2028-014
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@datumai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-02T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — retention / tracing / advanced dashboards pricing

Samantha — thanks for the clarifying questions and Kim/Rohan for the suggested commercial language. We're prepared to move forward with the following commitments to help you meet procurement timing:

1) Packaging & tiers: We'll include index-level retention (365d for infra, 90d for app traces) in the SOW.
2) Discounting: 18-month committed term at 15% off addon list prices as outlined in Rohan's workbook.
3) Smoothing & overage: For the first 90 days post-onboarding we'll credit 50% of any overage charges for spans above the committed slab to attenuate burst risk. After that window, standard slab pricing applies, with a renewal trigger if usage >150% of forecast.
4) Advanced visuals: Offer org license at $3,500/mo which includes auto-scaling for spikes up to 2x. Excess compute billed separately; we'll include a capped monthly excess rate in the SOW.

Two minor asks from our side to finalize: A) procurement contact (procurement@datumai.com) should confirm billing contact and legal reviewer, and B) acceptance of a rollback clause at renewal if your usage materially decreases (we will credit unused committed spend back into future invoices).

If that sounds good I'll have Legal and Commercial Ops push a draft SOW and the DocuSign link within 24 hours so you can meet the March 7 deadline.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: revised_SOW_docu_sign_link.txt
